title: Product Data Scientist
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  
  

Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  

Docusign's Product Data Science team is looking for a Data Scientist to support the development of key data products and capabilities to enable data-driven product development and decision making. In this role, you would be part of the Product Data Science team and work directly in partnership with a variety of stakeholders including but not limited to Product, Engineering and User Experience partners to support and empower them with data-driven actionable insights. You will be embedded in specific product spaces requiring you to establish and grow relationships. As a Data Scientist, you’ll dig into the data to uncover insights, identify opportunities for product improvements and new product development, define product metrics with goals, design experiments and develop data science models to drive customer experience, engagement, and adoption of Docusign’s products. If you are an experienced data scientist passionate about data-driven product development and building products and capabilities that enable a culture of “test and learn,” then this could be a great role for you.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Product Data Science.

**Responsibility**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to research, build and improve data analysis to identify opportunities for product improvements, new product features, product utilization, and improve customer experience, engagement, and retention
* Be the subject matter expert for driving the product data strategy for the areas you support
* Partner closely with the product managers, user researchers, engineers, and leadership to capture and prioritize potential insights, analysis, and data product opportunities that will drive maximum business impact
* Specify and help implement product telemetry, define key performance indicators with goals, and own and manage regular reports to create insights around product usage and success
* Partner with Global Data Analytics team to automate data pipelines to snowflake from different source systems
* Design and build automated dashboards that connect data from internal and external data sources, with visualizations and tools that allow business users to self-serve on their website data needs
* Partner with Product teams to design, administer, and analyze the results of A/B and multivariate tests and other ML models
* Leverage data to develop actionable analytical insights and present findings to senior management
* Evangelize models, frameworks, analysis, and insights with stakeholders and business partners
* Act with a sense of urgency and purpose, identify and resolve roadblocks, reach out to cross-functional team members to solicit input and/or assist when appropriate
  

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  
  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  
  

**What you bring**
------------------

  
  

**Basic**

* BA/BS degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Math, Computer Science, Economics, Finance) or equivalent practical experience
* 4+ years of experience in product analytics or data science within a SaaS/Cloud environment
* Proficiency with SQL and scripting languages (Python or R) for data manipulation, analysis, and ETL processes
* Hands-on experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, HEX) to create self-service dashboards and report insights
* Experience applying rigorous statistical methods and analytical techniques to solve business problems
* Experience designing, launching, and evaluating A/B and multivariate tests
* Track record of collaborating with technical teams (Engineering, Telemetry) and translating complex data into actionable insights for stakeholders

  

**Preferred**

* Strong leadership and cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to lead through influence across organizational lines
* Experience with advanced data analytics methodologies, including cohort analysis, user segmentation, and machine learning models
* Experience analyzing product usage or building telemetry for Generative AI and LLM-based products
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake) and modern transformation tools (e.g., dbt)
* Highly organized self-starter who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  
  

**Working here**

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

**AI in Our Hiring Process**
  
At Docusign, we embrace technology to enhance efficiency and create a better candidate experience. We may record or transcribe interviews using enterprise AI tools to assist with meeting notes and interview documentation so our teams can stay fully engaged in the conversation. All hiring decisions remain 100% human-led. You have the right to opt out at any time by notifying your recruiter or interview team, with zero impact on your candidacy.
  
We encourage using AI tools to research and prepare beforehand. However, to ensure an authentic evaluation, live AI assistance or external recording bots during interviews are not permitted.

Simpplr is the AI-powered intranet for unifying the digital workplace. It brings people, trusted knowledge, apps, and agents into a coherent digital experience. The platform serves as a digital hub supporting communications, engagement, employee services, and work. With low-code extensibility and enterprise-grade security and governance, Simpplr enables confident operation at scale. More than 1,000 organizations — including AAA, the NHS, Penske, and Moderna — trust Simpplr to keep their workforce informed, aligned, and productive. Learn more at simpplr.com.

**Architect /Sr Architect**
---------------------------

### **Location-****Gurgaon**

### **The Opportunity**

Simpplr is looking for a **Backend Architect** to design and build scalable systems that power our next generation of intelligent, AI-enabled products.

In this role, you will be responsible for architecting **AI platforms and backend systems**, working across microservices, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data models and graph databases. You will partner closely with engineering, product and AI teams to build reliable systems that can represent complex relationships between people, content, entities and enterprise data.

This is a **hands-on architecture role** for someone who has strong backend engineering fundamentals and has **practical experience designing or building Knowledge Graphs using graph databases such as Neo4j**.

You will design systems that connect four perspectives of an enterprise:

* **Company Graph:** People, teams, roles, permissions, applications, and organizational relationships.
* **Knowledge Graph:** The entities, concepts, facts, and relationships found in enterprise content.
* **Business Event Graph:** Actions, state changes, and events over time.
* **Telemetry Graph:** How agents, workflows, tools, and services execute and perform.

These graphs share identities and provide context for enterprise search, RAG, and intelligent agents. This role calls for someone who can move from business questions to sound data models, APIs, and production systems—and who enjoys building and reviewing the implementation.

  

### **What You'll Do**

* Define the architecture and technical direction.
* Design scalable and highly available **backend architectures, microservices and distributed systems**.
* Design **Knowledge Graph data models, entity relationships, ontologies and graph schemas**.
* Design APIs and services that enable applications to consume and interact with data.
* Work on **entity modeling, relationship modeling, entity resolution and graph traversal**.
* Design data ingestion and transformation pipelines to build and continuously update the Knowledge Graph from multiple enterprise data sources.
* Define approaches for **graph data quality, consistency, scalability and performance optimization**.
* Architect integrations across enterprise systems, APIs and data platforms.
* Design and review **HLD/LLD, system architecture, API contracts and technical specifications**.
* Work with AWS services and cloud-native technologies to build scalable and resilient platforms.
* Collaborate with AI/ML and product teams to make Knowledge Graph capabilities consumable by **search, RAG and intelligent/AI-powered applications**.
* Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, design discussions and mentoring of senior engineers.
* Identify technical risks, scalability bottlenecks and architectural improvements across the platform.

* **12+ years of experience** in backend engineering and software architecture, with significant experience designing large-scale distributed systems.
* Strong hands-on experience with **Java, Python, Go or similar backend technologies**.
* Proven experience designing **microservices, distributed systems and API-driven architectures**.
* Strong experience with **AWS and cloud-native architecture**.
* Hands-on experience with **Knowledge Graphs and graph databases**, preferably **Neo4j**.
* Experience designing data ingestion pipelines that transform structured/unstructured enterprise data into graph models.
* Strong understanding of **relational , NoSQL databases**, data modeling and distributed data systems.
* Experience designing highly scalable and fault-tolerant backend platforms.
* Strong understanding of **REST APIs, event-driven architecture, messaging and asynchronous processing**.
* Experience with system design, architecture patterns, scalability, performance and reliability.
* Ability to translate complex business and data requirements into scalable technical architecture.
* Deep hands-on experience with **AWS**, including designing secure, highly available, and cost-conscious production systems.
  

### **Good to Have**

* Experience building systems for **enterprise search, semantic search, RAG or AI-powered applications**.
* Understanding of **ontologies, taxonomy, entity resolution and semantic relationships**.
* Experience integrating Knowledge Graphs with **LLM/RAG or Agentic AI systems**.
* Experience with technologies such as **Kafka, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Spark or similar data platforms**.
* Experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads.
* Exposure to data governance, security, tenant isolation and enterprise SaaS architecture.
* Experience working in a **B2B SaaS / enterprise product environment**.
* **DevOps skills**: Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code such as Terraform or CloudFormation, monitoring, logging, and production troubleshooting.
  

  
  
  

.

Our process is designed to hear your unique story, thought process, and lived experience in real-time. Use of unauthorized AI tools may result in disqualification, as we want to ensure every candidate is evaluated on their own individual merits. We’re excited to meet the person behind the resume!

If you need assistive technology or AI tools for accessibility (e.g., live captioning), please notify your recruiter in advance. We are committed to providing an inclusive interview experience.

At Simpplr we believe that when work is good, life is better and that belief guides all we do. Including how we approach our flexible work model. Simpplr operates with a Hub-Hybrid-Remote model. This model is role-based with exceptions and provides employees with the flexibility that many have told us they want.

description:
We are looking for an experienced and dynamic **Team Lead – Air Quality** to lead and further develop our Air Quality capability within GCC India, supporting the UK business.

The successful candidate will provide **technical, people, operational and commercial leadership** to the India-based Air Quality team and act as a key interface with UK Air Quality leaders, Project Managers and multidisciplinary project teams.

The role will focus on delivering high-quality Air Quality consultancy services, developing technical capability, mentoring and growing the team, ensuring effective resource utilisation, and strengthening integration between the UK and GCC businesses.

  

**Technical Leadership & Project Delivery**

* Act as the **technical face of the GCC Air Quality team** , building credibility and strong working relationships with UK technical leaders and project teams.
* Provide technical leadership and oversight for complex **air quality assessments, dispersion modelling and environmental assessment** assignments.
* Lead and review qualitative and quantitative air quality assessments for infrastructure, development, industrial, energy and environmental projects.
* Oversee **industrial point-source modelling** , including emissions assessments and stack-height optimisation studies.
* Provide leadership on **road traffic and transport-related air quality assessments** and associated dispersion modelling.
* Lead **construction dust risk assessments and Dust Management Plans** , applying relevant IAQM guidance and appropriate mitigation measures.
* Provide technical oversight of **odour assessments** , air quality monitoring programmes and monitoring-data interpretation.
* Support Health Impact Assessments and air quality/environmental inputs to Environmental Statements where required.
* Ensure technical reports, models and deliverables meet agreed **UK regulatory, client and quality requirements** .

The existing GCC capability specifically includes air quality assessment and modelling, industrial point-source modelling, odour assessments, BREEAM-related indoor air quality work, HIA, construction dust assessments, monitoring and CFD

**Modelling & Digital Capability**

* Provide technical oversight and quality assurance for atmospheric dispersion modelling.
* Demonstrate strong practical understanding of modelling packages such as **ADMS Roads, ADMS and AERMOD** .
* Promote effective use of **ArcGIS and QGIS** for spatial analysis and presentation of air quality information.
* Support development of advanced modelling capability, including CFD where appropriate.
* Drive continuous improvement, automation and digital innovation within Air Quality workflows.

These tools align directly with the current GCC capability, which includes ADMS Roads 5.1, ADMS 6, AERMOD, ArcGIS, QGIS, Rhino, OpenFOAM and ParaView. Broader internal Air Quality material also identifies AERMOD and CALPUFF among dispersion-modelling platforms.

**People & Team Leadership**

* Provide visible, positive and inclusive leadership to the GCC Air Quality team.
* Manage the day-to-day activities of the team, including **workload allocation, resource planning and prioritisation** .
* Provide line management, coaching, mentoring and technical development for team members.
* Establish clear development plans and provide regular, constructive feedback.
* Support colleagues in progressing towards appropriate professional qualifications and memberships.
* Identify capability gaps and develop structured training and knowledge-sharing programmes.
* Support **recruitment, onboarding and succession planning** to build a sustainable Air Quality capability.
* Create a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement.

This mirrors the UK GCC Team Lead model used in Team Lead – Nature Services , which combines technical leadership with resource planning, professional development, commercial management and UK business engagement.

**UK Stakeholder & Client Engagement**

* Act as a key point of contact between the **GCC Air Quality team and the UK Air Quality business** .
* Establish trusted working relationships with UK technical leaders, Project Managers and Directors.
* Work collaboratively with UK colleagues to understand forward workload, resource demand and capability requirements.
* Participate in technical, project and client meetings, providing clear and credible Air Quality advice.
* Maintain strong internal client relationships and contribute towards high levels of client satisfaction.
* Seek regular feedback on GCC performance and translate feedback into measurable improvements.
* Promote effective knowledge exchange and a **One Team approach** between UK and GCC colleagues.

This follows the GCC leadership model of integrated UK-GCC delivery, capacity planning, quality-led delivery and capability growth.

**Commercial & Operational Management**

* Lead workload forecasting and resource planning for the Air Quality team.
* Ensure projects are delivered **to agreed programme, budget and quality requirements** .
* Monitor utilisation, project performance and other agreed operational KPIs.
* Support project financial management, including budgets, remaining hours, project controls and project closure.
* Identify appropriately skilled resources for project delivery.
* Manage delivery risks, changes and variations proactively.
* Support bids, proposals, fee estimates and development of new Air Quality workstreams.
* Identify opportunities to expand the range of services delivered from GCC.

Current Air Quality GCC activities already include opportunity creation, revenue-budget updates, cost analysis, project financial reporting, bid tracking and project closure support.

  

**Essential**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Atmospheric Science, Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering** or another relevant discipline.
* Significant professional experience in **Air Quality consultancy/environmental assessment** , ideally with exposure to UK projects.
* Strong technical experience in air quality impact assessment and atmospheric dispersion modelling.
* Demonstrable knowledge of **ADMS/ADMS Roads and/or AERMOD** .
* Experience delivering or reviewing air quality assessments for infrastructure, transport, industrial or development projects.
* Good understanding of construction dust, emissions assessment, monitoring and mitigation.
* Demonstrable experience of **leading projects and technically supervising or developing others** .
* Strong project management, commercial awareness and resource-management capability.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate confidently with senior stakeholders and clients.

**Desirable**

* Experience working directly on **UK Air Quality projects** and familiarity with the UK planning/environmental assessment environment.

* Experience of **CFD/OpenFOAM** , GIS or advanced data analysis.
* Experience supporting Environmental Impact Assessments and preparing Air Quality chapters for Environmental Statements.
* Experience contributing to bids, proposals and business development.
* Previous experience within a global delivery/GCC environment.

Professional affiliation with **IAQM/IES** is particularly relevant because those memberships already feature within the GCC Air Quality team's capability profile.

* People leadership and mentoring

At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

The incumbent will be responsible for controlling the project costs; This includes planning, developing, controlling, and forecasting the project’s budget and schedule. He / She will aim to minimize the deviation from the budget/ Schedule and ensure that the project is completed within the approved budget and timeline.

  

**6.** **Primary Job Functions**
================================

§ Familiarization with the process of project control procedures

§ Understanding Contract vis-à-vis project scope of work

§ Developing Cost WBS structure and control budget for the project based on the approved estimate.

§ Proactively monitor and communicate budget, actual status, and forecast costs/labor hours for projects monthly.

§ Consolidate performance data to support performance measurement, data analysis, and cost forecasting.

§ Assist in the development of project work plans and schedules.

§ Create client and internal status reports that effectively communicate schedule status and identify critical path.

§ Provide technical guidance to other project controls staff in project financial status

§ Ensuring all financials are in order, preparing spreadsheets and a wide variety of routine cost analyses, cash flow, and other cost related evaluations.

§ Set-up, monitor & report earned value progress measurement systems for projects, including analysis based on input from project leads

§ Identify business acumen by identifying for us potential project problems early, report issues and problems to operations leadership, and work with project teams to address and implement recovery plans.

§ Review of expenditure details, identifying incorrect charges, and commencement of the charge correction process will ensure our financials are accurate. To review, process, and track sub consultant invoices on various projects.

§ Prepare and update project schedules and cost/resource loading them.

§ Identify and drive optimizations in planning and execution of projects

§ Advise Project Controls Lead and Project Leadership Team of any potential schedule issues and when necessary, provide guidance on corrective action and measures to mitigate any adverse trends.

§ Develop and review schedule corrective actions and recovery plans and verify needed actions plans are implemented.

§ Review project changes to evaluate detail schedule impact; responsible for quantifying and incorporating the effect and impact of approved changes in the overall schedule stewardship and reporting.

§ Monitor and report on schedule implications of changes

§ Support project team with ongoing project progress measurement and schedule analysis, reporting, and forecasting activities.

§ Develop change management and maintaining change log.

§ Support in monitoring of cost developments of engineering/vendors/contractors and develop the cost reports.

§ Look for ways to reduce project costs and for ways to improve our work processes.

§ Perform price estimation and price budgeting from contract commitment to fit the baseline program

§ Provide planning / scheduling, and cost controlling mechanism for all projects which includes variation reporting, monitoring of milestone progress to the preparation of customer billing processes, etc.

§ Ensure effective project implementation and utilize productive reports from the creation of WBS with the use of project management system to monitor the status of the project.

§ Perform project costing related reporting to the team and management’s review monthly to ensure that expenditures are kept within the project budget.

§ Performing and/or managing the analysis of cost and risks for projects with a focus on support of project management.

§ Accountable for investment of project cost, and schedule and reports to the Project Manager of one or more projects during the planning and execution phase.

Here's what you'll need

  

§ Graduate / Advanced degree in Engineering or other technical disciplines

§ Experience in the infrastructure sector or in construction industry is highly preferable, with exposure in site engineering, project management, project planning, project costing, project scheduling, coordination, procurement and construction workflows.

§ Knowledge in cost control tools and technics to drive /contribute project financial health, knowledge in Estimation, Project / Cost Controlling, Project Tracking, Project Scheduling

§ Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of interdependency of underlying cost and schedule drivers.

§ Demonstrate excellent understanding of the entire system of the business, relationship between productivity vs profitability

§ Good team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills

§ Ability to communicate effectively (written and verbal) with project stakeholders and proficient to work in any project environment.

§ Ability to prioritize and organize assigned tasks in a timely manner.

§ Ability to follow company procedures and work independently without guidance

§ Proactive and analytic, becoming an integrated part of the team, despite remote engagement

The incumbent will have relationships with one or more of the following:

§ Project Managers, Senior Project Managers, Manager of Projects

§ Project Controllers, Planning Leads, Project Accountants, Commercial Analysts, Procurement

§ Mastery in MS Excel and strong skillset in other MS Office software (Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Outlook)

§ Proficiency in any other cost control tool

§ Knowledge in Planning software like MSP / Primavera, Power BI / Data Visualization software will provide an advantage

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.

  
  

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.

  
  

At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.

Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

The Capacity Analyst is a hands-on data and modelling role. It supports capacity forecasting for our Global Delivery Center & APAC businesses.
  
This is not a role for reporting what the system already shows. We need someone who can take raw, messy data, clean it, model it and forecast beyond what is available in the system. They add their own analysis and intelligence, and turn the result into clear visuals that leaders can act on.

Key areas of responsibility include: Data Preparation & Integrity, Forecasting & Modelling, Visualization & Insight, Scope & Collaboration.

* Correct known data issues (e.g. unrealistic demand swings) before they reach stakeholders
* Document data logic, assumptions and definitions so outputs are repeatable and auditable

* Maintain the supply & demand dashboard tracking demand change by role and skill
* Turn analysis into clear, visual data stories that show supply, demand and skills-profile challenges for leadership

description:
**Job title: DOM Specialist**
-----------------------------

* **Location:** **Hyderabad**
  ---------------------------

**About the job**
-----------------

Sanofi is a global life sciences company committed to improving access to healthcare and supporting the people we serve throughout the continuum of care. From prevention to treatment, Sanofi transforms scientific innovation into healthcare solutions, in human vaccines, rare diseases, multiple sclerosis, oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, diabetes and cardiovascular solutions. As a company with a global vision of drug development and a highly regarded corporate culture, Sanofi is recognized as one of the best pharmaceutical companies in the world and is pioneering the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) with strong commitment to develop advanced data standards to increase reusability & interoperability and thus accelerate impact on global health.

The People Services Tech Solutions team is a team of experts that helps Operations through global technologies such as Workday, I Learn. As part of the Document Operations Management (DOM) team, you will play a key role in managing the full documentation lifecycle while also supporting global Workday Core HCM. The role combines functional expertise, technical problem-solving, and cross‑functional collaboration to ensure high-quality documentation, compliant HR processes, and smooth
  
system operations.

**Main responsibilities:**

  

* The DOM Specialist plays a critical role in the maintenance, development, and implementation of HR IS systems. They are also key in helping to identify automation solutions and in participating in projects at a regional/global level, either as a member or as a leader. The scope includes recruitment, hiring & onboarding, termination & offboarding, talent management & development and Your Voice surveys as well as projects as part of the Workday roadmap, Global/local Workday projects or Global/local projects connected to Workday as a source system. Provide Level 2 functional and technical support and follow through to resolution in an effective and timely manner

* Understand change requirements at global and regional levels and translate them into actionable process and system changes. Conduct impact and root cause analysis, manage communications, and influence decisions to align with the support model and the business strategic objectives. Initiate change requests, test and implement system updates. Liaise with key stakeholders to identify pain points and implement sustainable solutions to ensure a high level of quality for Core HR master data. Contribution to Change Management roadmap as part of support activities, local contribution to end-user user adoption and continuous feedback.
* Knowledge management through the team and the development of local tools to ensure a high level of support (documentation, knowledge sharing…), contribution to knowledge transfer and education of first levels of support (Employee Contact Center, P&C Partners, HR Data Management teams). Cooperate transversally to serve as a liaison between People Services and Digital to provide systems support and analysis to leverage technology solutions to meet the needs of end users of HR and non-HR systems. Work closely with the People Services People Life Cycle GPO team, as well as all stakeholders such as P&C, R&P, Talent Acquisition, Internal Control, Digital Operations, to ensure constant alignment. Work closely with the Captive Centre’s in the management of Support & Service Requests, and in identifying synergies. Ensure compliance with internal control requirements of Globally defined Model, according to People Services Global Core Model
* Documentation Operations (DOM) - Manage the complete documentation lifecycle including creation, maintenance, revision, conversion, and alignment across systems. Collaborate with internal departments to ensure documents meet business, compliance, and regulatory requirements. Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation across all HR processes and ensure adherence to company standards

* DOM System Support - Create and update documents using Doc Gen functionality. Update existing BIRT-based documents as required. Build and update text blocks and conditional logic rules. Create, update, and maintain document questionnaires. Troubleshoot issues related to calculated fields used in documents. Manage signatory roles, text updates, and configuration for electronic signature processes. Workday Functional & Technical Support In Core HR, Recruiting, Talent & Employee Lifecycle. Provide Level 2 functional and technical support for global Workday processes, ensuring timely analysis and resolution. Support processes across hiring, onboarding, offboarding, talent management, development, and engagement surveys. Understand global and regional change requirements and translate them into system and process updates. Configuration, Change Requests & Releases. Initiate, configure, test, and deploy Workday change requests. Perform root cause analysis and impact assessments for issues and enhancements. Assess, test, and validate functional enhancements for Workday’s semi-annual releases. Lead communications and alignment activities with impacted stakeholders
* HR Data Quality & Global Process Support - Work with key stakeholders to identify data-quality issues and implement sustainable improvements. Provide support for global HR processes, including data preparation, corrections, data loads, and issue resolution. Ensure alignment with the global HR Core Model and internal control requirements. Knowledge Management & Cross‑Functional Collaboration. Drive documentation and knowledge sharing within the support model. Support education and upskilling of Level 1 teams (Employee Contact Centre, HR Partners, Data Management). Act as a liaison between People Services, Digital teams, GPOs, and regional stakeholders to ensure consistent adoption of processes and technology

**About you:**

* **Experience:** 8+ years’ experience Workday Environment Experience in assisting with Global Projects.
* **Soft skills:** Ability to work in an international and functional matrix environment. Ability to interact with internal and external stakeholders in a professional manner. Team player, able to work collaboratively transversally with an end-to-end mindset. Good communication skills. Attentive to customer needs and feedback. Ability to organize, prioritize and structure the workload for oneself, the team, as well as for stakeholders. Action oriented, delivery driven, change agent, responsive. Solution oriented, deductive and analytical skills. Ability to identify the proper solution to address a specific business issue. Ability to translate from a business requirement to a technical requirement and provide an applicable solution to the business

* **Technical skills:** To ensure DOM support, the following Workday certificates are mandatory: **Workday Core HCM/ Workday Reporting Mandatory.** Calculated Fields Report Writer, Business Process Fundamentals. Good understanding of People & Culture / Human Capital Management related tools & systems e.g. Workday, Appical (Sanofi On boarder).Profound Knowledge of Microsoft Applications.
* **Education:** Any Bachelor’s degree.
* **Languages**: Excellent knowledge of English language (spoken and written).

**Why choose us?**

  

* Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
* Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
* Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
* Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention, and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.
* Opportunity to work in an international environment, collaborating with diverse business teams and vendors, working in a dynamic team, and fully empowered to propose and implement innovative ideas.

description:
About the Team  
  
The Strategy and Transformation team for Uber’s Field Operations organization sets the vision and strategy for Field Ops, runs agent operations, leads complex transformation projects, and drives optimization of our global operations.  
  
Our work spans five pillars: Special Projects, Strategy and Programs, Business Planning and Improvement, Transformation, and Analytics. Within Special Projects, we solve ambiguous, cross-functional challenges and build the operational capabilities that enable Field Ops to scale.  
  
About the Role  
  
As Program Leader, Translation and Tech, you will lead the deployment, optimization, and scaling of translation technologies, AI-enabled capabilities, and operational tools across Uber’s global Field Operations network.  
  
You will turn operational needs into clear business cases and implementation plans, partnering with Product, Engineering, and regional teams to make technology work effectively across languages, markets, and workflows. Your ownership will span pilots, integration dependencies, operational readiness, rollout, adoption, and ongoing performance improvement.  
  
This role combines technical fluency, analytical problem-solving, and hands-on program leadership. You will evaluate translation quality and operational effectiveness, navigate regional requirements with specialist partners, and ensure technology delivers measurable improvements in productivity, quality, and service.  
  
What You’ll Do  

* **Lead translation technology programs:** Evaluate and scale translation solutions across languages, regions, and operational workflows. Establish quality measures, identify limitations, and coordinate improvements with technical and operational partners.
* **Deploy new technology and AI capabilities:** Own programs from problem definition and business case through pilot, rollout, stabilization, and operational handover.
* **Manage integrations and dependencies:** Partner with Product and Engineering to clarify requirements, understand system and data dependencies, resolve implementation barriers, and coordinate delivery.
* **Adapt solutions to operating environments:** Redesign workflows and implementation approaches to accommodate regional needs while maintaining consistent operational standards.
* **Build business cases and measure impact:** Assess benefits, costs, and trade-offs. Establish baselines and track translation quality, adoption, productivity, cost, and operational reliability.
* **Drive readiness and adoption:** Partner with Center of Excellence (COE), Global Shared Services (GSS), and regional teams on testing, training, communications, support, and feedback mechanisms.
* **Coordinate privacy and compliance requirements:** Work with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and other specialist teams to identify and address requirements before deployment.
* **Run program governance:** Maintain clear ownership, milestones, risks, dependencies, and escalation paths. Communicate progress, trade-offs, and decisions to senior stakeholders.

  
Basic Qualifications  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum 8 years of professional experience in program management, technology implementation, or technology-enabled operations, including leading complex, cross-functional programs.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional programs involving technology implementation, operational tools, or AI-enabled workflow improvements.
* Experience working directly with Product and Engineering teams to translate business needs into requirements and deliver solutions into live operations.
* Strong technical fluency, with the ability to understand integrations, data flows, system dependencies, and operational constraints.
* Strong analytical skills and experience building business cases, defining success measures, and tracking outcomes.
* Proven ability to structure ambiguous problems, manage competing priorities, and drive execution across multiple stakeholders.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences and influence without direct authority.

  
Preferred Qualifications  

* Experience deploying or managing machine translation, AI-assisted translation, localization technology, or multilingual operational tools.
* Familiarity with evaluating translation or AI output quality, including identifying failure modes and establishing appropriate human review and escalation processes.
* Experience scaling technology across multiple countries, languages, or distributed operational teams.
* Experience delivering programs in customer support, shared services, or other large-scale service operations.
* Experience partnering with specialist teams on data privacy, security, or regulatory requirements during technology rollouts.
* Experience driving change management, user adoption, and sustained performance improvement following deployment.

  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

title: Manager, Security Business Analysis
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

* Serve as a hands-on leader, personally handling day-to-day customer audits, RFPs, and security questionnaires alongside leading the team.
* Oversee customer security audits, RFPs, security questionnaires, and evidence gathering through standardized, scalable processes that deliver accurate, timely responses.
* Lead customer-facing security engagements, including executive briefings, escalations, pre-/post-sales assessments, and security presentations, positioning the team as a trusted advisor on customer assurance and GRC.
* Review customer contracts (MSAs, SOWs, DPAs, security addendums) to identify required security, privacy, and confidentiality clauses; partner with Legal, Privacy, and Product to negotiate terms that limit risk and align with SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR.
* Maintain Customer Trust documentation, contract guidance, knowledge base materials, and security collateral, validating current information with internal stakeholders.
* Partner with Sales, Success Management, and Support on customer security needs; track recurring requirements and share them to inform future security posture enhancements.
* Support the GRC program, including policy and standards management, control documentation, and alignment to SOC 2, ISO 27001/27002, and NIST 800-53.
* Coordinate internal and external compliance audits and certifications, including evidence collection, auditor communication, and remediation tracking.
* Contribute to risk assessments and the risk register, and monitor regulatory and framework changes, translating them into updated controls, policies, and customer-facing guidance.

**People Management Responsibilities:**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a geographically distributed team, setting clear expectations and providing coaching, feedback, and career development guidance.
* Oversee workload, prioritization, and quality across customer audits, RFPs, security assessments, and GRC activities, ensuring on-time delivery.
* Navigate cultural, regulatory, and operational differences across regions, adapting to local requirements while keeping execution consistent.
* Implement workforce planning to maintain continuity during peak compliance and customer-assurance cycles.
* Foster an equitable, transparent, and collaborative environment where global staff feel engaged and empowered.

**Process improvement Responsibilities**

* Lead process improvement and automation that enhance efficiency, scalability, and quality across customer audits, security assessments, GRC workflows, and documentation delivery.
* Define and standardize operational procedures, knowledge-sharing practices, and documentation.
* Mature Customer Trust dashboards, metrics, KPIs, and board-level reporting to track delivery of customer-requested items, surface security and compliance risks, and identify improvement priorities.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical/security field, or a non-technical degree with relevant Customer Trust and GRC experience.
* 5+ years of experience in Customer Trust, GRC, Assurance, Security Compliance, or related roles.
* 3+ years of experience leading teams, projects, or workstreams, with exposure to distributed or global environments.
* Strong security knowledge and technical acumen to explain security controls and risk to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Expertise in RFPs, customer audits, security narratives, and customer security presentations.
* Experience building and scaling Customer Trust/GRC processes (security reviews, questionnaires, evidence management, knowledge sharing), with metrics, KPIs, and dashboards covering response times, workload, quality, and program effectiveness.
* Knowledge of frameworks such as ISO 27001/27002 and NIST 800-53, and of risks relevant to customer assurance, including cloud security, operational resilience, privacy, and regulatory exposure.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder skills, with the ability to simplify complex risk topics.
* Analytical rigor, process analysis and control documentation skills, and evidence-backed decision-making.
* Experience with Customer Trust and GRC tools; relevant AI experience preferred, such as AI-enabled questionnaire responses and knowledge management with human review, accuracy checks, and protection of confidential information.
* Accountability, integrity, and ownership of programs, with the ability to work independently with minimal direction.
* Ability to collaborate across complex business lines, globally and remotely.

**We focus on our mission**: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.

* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

**We invest in our people**: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**IAM Specialist-Digital Certificate/EKMS Services**

Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information, which means that data is even more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and therefore everyone in EY Information Security has an important role to play. Join a global team of almost 900 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond when things go wrong. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology service solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through secure solutions and information systems.

  

**The opportunity**
-------------------

Identity and Access Management (IAM) organization, a part of Information Security which, enables over 330,000 individuals across 140+ countries to access systems and information securely. As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, including but not limited to security for, a complex Active Directory (AD) environment, hybrid cloud deployment, mobile computing, policy driven security, SSO, identity lifecycle management, and federation focusing on multiple protocols.

We offer opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career receiving support, coaching and feedback from colleagues around the world. This role will give you an opportunity to work with some of the best talent in the industry!

  

**Your key responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Manage L3 Incidents, Service Requests and problems related to affected services
* Manage and maintain Public Key Infrastructure Document PKI and certificate management guidance for the company
* Responsible for infrastructure design and the planning and implementation of changes within the environment
* Sponsor changes to the infrastructure needed to support new and evolving services, technologies, and applications
* KPI analysis to identify patterns and trends and drive performance improvement
* Benchmarking, productivity, and quality control
* Ownership of process engineering and operational improvement initiatives including automation tooling
* Provide first line support to internal clients and member organization on EKMS.
* Support EKMS onboarding and offboarding processes for both cloud and on-premises applications
* Provide operational support and triage on HSM and EKMS during incident response.
* Support Azure Managed HSM (MHSM) onboarding operations as it relates to applications requiring TLS offloading.
* Under the supervision of EKMS Engineering, support the Firm’s day-to-day operations as it relates to on-premises applications requiring TLS offloading.
* Implement operational improvements as it relates to enterprise key management and HSM support.
* Maintain and update the enterprise key management documentation to support new business requirements.
* Support HSMs operations as it relates to Nginx and Windows Internet Information Services.
* Provide Level 1 and 2 support to end user related on key management which has a direct impact of the Recovery Time Objective (RTO).
* Escalate advance key management issues which has a direct impact on service delivery to EKMS Engineers or Vendors where necessary
* Maintain the operations runbook for HSM and EKMS deployments.
* Root cause analysis and service improvement solutions
* Provide cost-efficient, stable operations for the platforms and services in scope
* Align risk and control processes into day to day responsibilities to monitor and mitigate risk; escalates appropriately
* Produce accurate, brief and clearly written documents tailored to audience needs and expectations
* Flexibility to work in a 24\*7 support structure.

**Skills and attributes for success**
-------------------------------------

* Excellent problem-solving skills
* Strong verbal and written skills to interact with global teams and customers
* Keep up on current technologies and maintain awareness of industry trends and threats, focusing on PKI technologies.
* Tangible, relevant, and demonstrable experience with PKI and specifically Microsoft PKI technology, integration with platforms and applications, and working with clients.
* Perform analysis of metrics for the purpose of making decisions around staffing, capacity, and processes.
* Experience in Key Management Operations related to Key Generation, Storage, Distribution, Rotation, Revocation and Destruction.
* Experience with at least one enterprise key management systems as well as cloud-based key management services.
* Operational experience working with two or more of the following protocols: TLS, PKI, HSMs, KMIP, Digital Certificate Management, Azure Key Vault, or transparent database encryption.
* Basic experience with FIPS 140-2 Level 3 compliance requirements and implementation.

**To qualify for the role, you must****have**
---------------------------------------------

* Degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent work experience
* Fluent in English language – written and verbal
* Minimum of 5 years of experience with Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)
* Experience with key PKI technologies such as Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services including Certificate Authority, NDES, and OCSP and HSMs
* 2 years’ experience in enterprise key management, HSM configuration, application layer encryption, and transparent data encryption.

**About Payoneer**

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world's underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We're a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

**About Payoneer Workforce Management (WFM)**

Payoneer Workforce Management (WFM) is Payoneer's global workforce solutions business, helping companies hire, onboard, pay, and manage talent anywhere in the world. The business enables organizations to build international teams quickly and compliantly without the need to establish legal entities in every country where they hire.

As remote and distributed workforces become increasingly common, companies face challenges related to employment compliance, payroll, benefits administration, contractor management, and local labor regulations. Payoneer WFM simplifies these complexities through technology-enabled workforce solutions and in-country expertise.

**What We Do:** Payoneer WFM provides end-to-end solutions that help businesses:

* Engage and manage contractors compliantly
* Process global payroll across multiple countries and currencies
* Manage onboarding and offboarding processes
* Ensure compliance with local employment and labor laws
* Handle benefits administration and workforce operations
* Support international expansion without requiring entity setup

Today, Payoneer WFM supports businesses across more than 160 countries, enabling them to access talent globally while maintaining compliance and operational efficiency.

The platform enables businesses to:

* Hire employees and contractors in 160+ countries
* Run global payroll in 70+ currencies
* Manage onboarding, contracts, benefits, compliance, expenses, and offboarding from a single platform
* Navigate local labor laws, tax requirements, and employment regulations across jurisdictions.

Employer of Record (EOR): A key offering within WFM is Employer of Record (EOR). Under the EOR model, Payoneer WFM becomes the legal employer of an individual in their local country while the client company manages the employee's day-to-day responsibilities, goals, and performance.

This allows organizations to hire talent internationally without establishing a local subsidiary or legal entity. Payoneer WFM manages employment contracts, payroll, taxes, statutory benefits, and compliance requirements, enabling clients to focus on growing their business.

Why This Market Matters: The global workforce landscape has changed significantly over the last few years. Companies are increasingly adopting remote and distributed hiring models, allowing them to access talent regardless of geography. As a result, the demand for global employment solutions, international payroll, and compliance management has grown rapidly.

How WFM Fits Within Payoneer: Payoneer is widely recognized as a global financial technology company that enables businesses to send, receive, and manage cross-border payments worldwide. Workforce Management extends this mission by helping businesses not only move money globally but also hire and manage talent globally. Together, these solutions enable companies to build, operate, and scale international businesses more efficiently.

Payoneer WFM is helping redefine how companies build global teams, making international hiring simpler, faster, and more accessible for businesses around the world.

The role includes model governance, technical reviews, mentoring, issue resolution and disciplined execution of BIM workflows.
  
The position is responsible for cost-effective and high-quality BIM delivery across multiple concurrent projects, from moderate assignments to major multidisciplinary work packages, aligned with contract requirements, programme milestones, safety-in-design principles and agreed BIM information requirements.

  

Technical Development and Project Delivery

* Lead the development and delivery of coordinated civil and structural Revit models, drawings, schedules and BIM outputs for substations and associated energy infrastructure.
* Establish and maintain project Revit templates, worksets, model structures, shared coordinates, naming conventions, object libraries and modelling standards.
* Develop and review models for substation buildings, control buildings, equipment foundations, transformer and reactor bunds, fire walls, cable trenches, ducts, pits, drainage, roads, fencing and general site infrastructure.
* Coordinate civil and structural models with primary plant, secondary systems, cables, earthing, mechanical, architectural, geotechnical and other discipline inputs.
* Create and manage federated models and undertake model coordination, interference checking and clash detection using Autodesk Navisworks or equivalent platforms.
* Ensure models and drawings comply with the project BIM Execution Plan, client requirements, Common Data Environment procedures, ISO 19650 principles and applicable WSP quality processes.
* Carry out model health checks, drawing reviews and QA/QC checks, and ensure model issues are recorded, assigned, tracked and closed before formal issue.
* Confirm completeness of assigned BIM packages and verify that interdisciplinary reviews, design changes and model revisions are documented in the project-specific storage environment.
* Support the production of 2D drawings from coordinated models, including general arrangements, plans, sections, elevations, details, reinforcement information and schedules.
* Provide technical input to information delivery plans, model responsibility matrices, BIM execution planning and project-specific modelling strategies.
* Prepare work plans, resource estimates and delivery programmes for BIM/Revit activities, and monitor progress against agreed budgets and milestones.
* Identify and implement efficient, repeatable and innovative workflows, including appropriate use of Dynamo, Python and model-checking automation.
* Maintain design issue logs, model review records and change-control information, and communicate project impacts arising from changes.
* Contribute to risk and opportunity registers, close-out reports and lessons learned, ensuring improvements are applied to subsequent projects.
* Understand and follow WSP health, safety and environment procedures and support safety by design through clear, coordinated and buildable model outputs.

Team Leadership and Capability Development

* Plan, prioritise and allocate BIM/Revit work across the team, balancing project needs, available capability and development opportunities.
* Lead, mentor and technically support BIM coordinators, senior modellers, technicians and early-career professionals.
* Provide clear task briefs, review outputs, give constructive feedback and ensure timely closure of review comments.
* Develop consistent standards, reusable content, checklists and guidance to improve quality and efficiency across UK and India delivery teams.
* Support technical interviews, onboarding, training and competency development for Civil & Structural BIM resources.
* Promote collaborative working between engineers and BIM/CAD professionals so that modelling is integrated into the design process rather than treated as a separate drafting activity.

Commercial and Client Development

* Build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external clients, project managers, discipline leads and delivery partners.
* Contribute to bids and proposals by defining BIM scope, deliverables, assumptions, exclusions, resource requirements, hours and programme.
* Identify opportunities for multidisciplinary and digital-delivery services, including standardisation, automation and data-rich model outputs.
* Support efficient project delivery by monitoring budget, programme, scope change and resource utilisation within the area of responsibility.
* Represent the Civil & Structural BIM discipline in project meetings, model coordination workshops, design reviews and client discussions.

Required Technical Skills

* Advanced competency in Autodesk Revit for civil, structural and multidisciplinary model delivery.
* Strong experience with Autodesk Navisworks Manage for federated model review, clash detection and coordination.
* Good working knowledge of AutoCAD; Civil 3D and Autodesk Construction Cloud are advantageous.
* Practical understanding of structural steelwork, reinforced concrete, foundations, buildings and associated civil infrastructure.
* Experience developing construction drawings and schedules from coordinated BIM models.
* Understanding of BIM information management, Common Data Environment workflows and ISO 19650 principles.
* Ability to assess model quality, performance, geometry, information completeness and drawing presentation.
* Experience with Dynamo and/or Python for automation is desirable.
* Experience in UK transmission and distribution, substations or comparable major infrastructure is strongly preferred.

Leadership and Soft Skills.

Leadership

* Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate and organise a multidisciplinary BIM team.
* Proven experience in mentoring and developing team members while maintaining delivery accountability.
* Ability to make sound technical and delivery decisions and escalate material risks promptly.

Communication

* Excellent verbal, written and visual communication skills.
* Ability to explain complex BIM and coordination issues clearly to engineering, project and client stakeholders.
